Split out of legacy-g5.json (2026-09-17): 0xC049 is a revised 2007 hardware revision ('G5 V2') sold with a box sticker reading 'Now with 2 thumb buttons', a 9-button layout distinct from the original 6-button 0xC041 unit. Evidence is community/press-tier (Techgage, APH Networks reviews quoting official box/press copy), not an official Logitech spec page -- none could be found still live for this model. libratbag already tracks 0xC041 and 0xC049 as two separate .device files, which this split mirrors.

Button count/composition (9: L, R, Middle, Back, Forward, DPI+, DPI-, wheel-tilt-left, wheel-tilt-right) is inferred from press descriptions rather than a numbered official diagram; exact left-to-right tilt order and precise DPI +/- button positions are unconfirmed (CHECK).
